sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.alignment_id IN (
        SELECT id FROM alignment WHERE alignment = 'Bad'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) AS percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.publisher_id = (
        SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
    ) AND T1.alignment_id IN (
        SELECT id FROM alignment WHERE alignment = 'Bad'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_count
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id
LEFT JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.alignment = 'Bad'
